name: Quant V6.2 - ampliar radar de observacao

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  install:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Aplicar patch conservador
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          p=Path('quant-unified-bot.js')
          s=p.read_text()
          if 'QUANT_V62_EXTRA_ASSETS' in s:
              print('V6.2 ja instalado; sem alteracoes')
              raise SystemExit(0)
          old="""const DEFAULT = {"""
          new="""// QUANT_V62_EXTRA_ASSETS: SOMENTE OBSERVACAO, nunca entram na carteira.
          // Cinco simbolos extras por ciclo; os 20 sao cobertos em quatro ciclos.
          const EXTRA_ASSETS = [
            'ETC','FIL','ATOM','OP','INJ',
            'SEI','PEPE','SHIB','TON','ICP',
            'HBAR','ALGO','GRT','JUP','WIF',
            'BONK','SAND','MANA','CRV','RENDER'
          ];
          const TRADEABLE_ASSETS = new Set(ASSETS);

          const DEFAULT = {"""
          if s.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit('ERRO: ancora DEFAULT inesperada')
          s=s.replace(old,new,1)
          old="""  return ASSETS.map(sym=>{"""
          new="""  // Observacao adicional em rodizio; limite de cinco moedas novas por scan.
          const slot=Math.floor(Date.now()/SCAN_MS)%4;
          const extra=EXTRA_ASSETS.slice(slot*5,slot*5+5);
          return [...ASSETS,...extra].map(sym=>{"""
          if s.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit('ERRO: ancora universe inesperada')
          s=s.replace(old,new,1)
          old="""  const approved=results.filter(x=>x.approved)
              .sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.spread-b.spread);"""
          new="""  // Apenas as 20 moedas originais continuam autorizadas para compra.
            const approved=results.filter(x=>x.approved&&TRADEABLE_ASSETS.has(x.sym))
              .sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.spread-b.spread);"""
          if s.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit('ERRO: ancora approved inesperada')
          s=s.replace(old,new,1)
          old="""  st.stats.rejected+=results.length-approved.length;"""
          new="""  st.stats.rejected+=results.filter(x=>TRADEABLE_ASSETS.has(x.sym)).length-approved.length;"""
          if s.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit('ERRO: ancora stats inesperada')
          s=s.replace(old,new,1)
          old="""    ' entradas elegiveis / 20 moedas | '+"""
          new="""    ' entradas elegiveis / 20 negociaveis + 5 extras observadas | '+"""
          if s.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit('ERRO: ancora diagnostic inesperada')
          s=s.replace(old,new,1)
          p.write_text(s)
          print('V6.2 instalado: 20 negociaveis, 20 extras em rodizio, 5 por ciclo')
          PY
          node --check quant-unified-bot.js
      - name: Commit e push somente se houver mudanca
        run: |
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add quant-unified-bot.js
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "Quant V6.2: observar 20 moedas extras sem novas compras"
            git push
          else
            echo 'Nada a alterar'
          fi
